headline: Weathered Expanse Recoils Under Heavy Fire as Northern Sectors Shift
war_summary: Since our previous edition, the northern perimeter has shifted rapidly, led by a dramatic Warden rebound in Weathered Expanse where six strategic redoubts are now held against one Colonial position and two neutral expanses. The sector remains the war's most violent theater, recording eight base transitions and more than thirteen hundred casualties over the past two hours alone, primarily around contested Wightwalk. To the west, the deadlock along the Nevish Line fractured into renewed combat, with five turnovers in two hours tipping the sector to a 5–3 Warden advantage amidst heavy skirmishing at Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way. Mooring County continues to burn with over thirteen hundred fresh casualties in two hours, punctuated by immediate base actions at MacConmara Barrows that leave Wardens in control of nine bases to two Colonial holdings and one neutral site. Callahan’s Passage sustains severe bloodletting with nearly a thousand casualties in two hours, though base lines held firm through the latest watch. Conversely, the ferocious shelling that recently gripped Marban Hollow has collapsed into sudden quiet, joining Kuura Strand and Fishermans Row in relative operational silence.
